messages.subject: error in dsm.cor
parts:
Hello everyone.
I'm running a DSM and when trying to run dsm.cor I get the following error

dsm.cor(dsm.est.nb9,resid.type="d", max.lag=9, Segment.Label="Sample.Label")

Error in dsm.cor(dsm.est.nb9, resid.type = "d", max.lag = 9, Segment.Label = "Sample.Label") : 
  No column called Transect.Label in data

I tried adding Transect.Label="Transect.Label" but I get the same problem.
The head of the column is "Transect.Label" in all the files used in dsm. What could be happening?

Many thanks!

Antonella
